newsitem.title: USA: Damen holders seek board size increase.
newsitem.headline: Damen holders seek board size increase.

text.p: A group including Jackson Equity and Jackson Partners said Tuesday it would like to see Damen Financial Corp increase the size of its board of directors by two persons.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group also said it would like to see the company pay a one-time special dividend.

The group also recommended reinstituting stock buybacks. However, Damen had already undertaken this effort on February 28 when it offered to repurchase up to 850,000 common shares, which represents 22.5 percent of its 3,770,117 outstanding shares.
The group said it had originally acquired the shares for investment purposes, but now wanted to influence management.
Its latest transactions include the purchase of 3,000 common shares on January 30 at a price of $13.25 per share.
Jackson Equity holds 118,700 common shares or a 3.16 percent stake in Damen, while Jackson Partners holds 250,800 common, or 6.7 percent of the company's outstanding shares.
